en.title: Checksum Aggregator (Fortinet OA)
en.description: Over all ordered index pairs with 1≤i,j≤n, sum C(i,j)=i mod j+j mod i, modulo 1,000,000,007. The statement requires the two indices to be distinct; diagonal terms are zero. The input/output protocol is added by this site.
en.output: Output the sum of the checksum over all distinct ordered pairs, modulo 1000000007.
en.explanation: For each fixed j, split the remainders over 1..n into complete periods and a tail.
hints: Fix j; the remainders repeat every j terms.
Summed over all ordered pairs, i mod j and j mod i give the same total.
